# Microservice API Gateway Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Microservices

## Overview

Implements API gateways for microservice architectures with routing, authentication, rate limiting, and request transformation

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [microservice-api-gateway-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
microservice-api-gateway-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@microservice-api-gateway-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure API gateway routing rules
- Implement centralized authentication
- Set up rate limiting and throttling
- Configure request/response transformation

## Technology Standards Applied

- **API Gateway**: Gateway pattern and implementation options
- **Rate Limiting**: Traffic control at the edge
- **Authentication**: Centralized auth at gateway level
